MLPro is a middleware framework for standardized machine learning in Python. It is developed by the South Westphalia University of Applied Sciences, Germany, and provides standards, templates, and processes for hybrid machine learning applications. PettingZoo, in turn, provides a diverse suite of environments for multi-agent reinforcement learning. MLPro-Int-PettingZoo offers wrapper classes that allow the reuse of environments from PettingZoo in MLPro, or the other way around. ### Learn more [MLPro - The integrative middleware framework for
